changes.comment: A reader of one key of a ReactiveMap, or one value of a ReactiveSet, depends on a relay the collection wakes by one lookup, where each key held a filtered subscription to every event of the collection. A write no longer runs a predicate per key being read, and tracking a key costs one node. A reader of the key NaN is now woken by a write to it, where only clear() reached it. One write wakes the readers of the whole collection (size and the iterators) first and the readers of its key after them.
